question: Read the job posting between the content markers and classify it. For role_fit, compare the role with the target roles stated before the title; if none are stated, compare it with early-career software, ML or systems engineering roles. Choose not_stated or the closest option only from what the posting actually says.

context.summary_whitespace: collapse runs of whitespace to one space, trim both ends
context.truncate: cut at max_bytes, then back to a UTF-8 rune boundary

families.question: How well does this job posting fit the target roles stated before the title? If none are stated, compare it with early-career software, ML or systems engineering roles.

options.description: The role's core work matches the target roles and its level is appropriate.
Part of the work matches the target roles but a significant part does not.
A neighbouring field or function; related skills apply but it is not the target work.
The work is in an unrelated domain or function.
The work matches but the required level is far above or below an early-career engineer.

families.question: What does this job posting say about visa sponsorship and work authorization?

options.description: The posting says it sponsors work visas or supports relocation and immigration.
The posting says it does not sponsor visas or requires existing work authorization.
The posting requires citizenship, permanent residency or a security clearance.
The posting says nothing about sponsorship or work authorization.

families.question: Where does this job posting say the work is done?

options.description: The role mixes office and remote days.
The role requires working from an office full time.
The posting does not say where the work is done.

families.question: What level of seniority does this job posting ask for?

options.description: A mid-level individual contributor role, roughly 2 to 5 years of experience.
A senior individual contributor role, roughly 5 or more years of experience.
A staff, principal or distinguished individual contributor role.
A role managing people: manager, director or head of.
